\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 291-293 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R296-first-pass-words-from-chapters-291-293}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a carpet and a bedsheet.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a creeper, an animal, a deer, a bull, a wolf
  \item a wave, moonlight, a storm, a flood, a sofa
  \item a television, technology, a magazine, a channel, a programme
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A creeper? (\textbf{\ml{വള്ളി}}, \emph{vaḷḷi}.) An animal? (\textbf{\ml{ജന്തു}}, \emph{jantu}.) A deer? (\textbf{\ml{മാൻ}}, \emph{mān}.) A bull? (\textbf{\ml{കാള}}, \emph{kāḷa}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\ml{ചെന്നായ}}, \emph{cennāya}.) A wave? (\textbf{\ml{തിര}}, \emph{tira}.) Moonlight? (\textbf{\ml{നിലാവ്}}, \emph{nilāvŭ}.) A storm? (\textbf{\ml{കൊടുങ്കാറ്റ്}}, \emph{koṭuṅkāṟṟŭ}.) A flood? (\textbf{\ml{വെള്ളപ്പൊക്കം}}, \emph{veḷḷappokkaṁ}.) A sofa? (\textbf{\ml{സോഫ}}, \emph{sōpha}.) A television? (\textbf{\ml{ടിവി}}, \emph{ṭivi}.) Technology? (\textbf{\ml{സാങ്കേതികവിദ്യ}}, \emph{sāṅkētikavidya}.) A magazine? (\textbf{\ml{മാസിക}}, \emph{māsika}.) A channel? (\textbf{\ml{ചാനൽ}}, \emph{cānal}.) A programme? (\textbf{\ml{പരിപാടി}}, \emph{paripāṭi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 294-296 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R296-second-pass-words-from-chapters-294-296}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a point of view and a matchbox.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a point of view, a matchbox, a padlock, a chain, a stick
  \item a pressure cooker, a mixer-grinder, a grinding stone, a mortar, a pestle
  \item a door frame, a cowshed, a light bulb, a carpet, a bedsheet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A point of view? (\textbf{\ml{കാഴ്ചപ്പാട്}}, \emph{kāḻcappāṭŭ}.) A matchbox? (\textbf{\ml{തീപ്പെട്ടി}}, \emph{tīppeṭṭi}.) A padlock? (\textbf{\ml{താഴ്}}, \emph{tāḻŭ}.) A chain? (\textbf{\ml{ചങ്ങല}}, \emph{caṅṅala}.) A stick? (\textbf{\ml{വടി}}, \emph{vaṭi}.) A pressure cooker? (\textbf{\ml{കുക്കർ}}, \emph{kukkar}.) A mixer-grinder? (\textbf{\ml{മിക്സി}}, \emph{miksi}.) A grinding stone? (\textbf{\ml{അമ്മി}}, \emph{ammi}.) A mortar? (\textbf{\ml{ഉരൽ}}, \emph{ural}.) A pestle? (\textbf{\ml{ഉലക്ക}}, \emph{ulakka}.) A door frame? (\textbf{\ml{കട്ടിള}}, \emph{kaṭṭiḷa}.) A cowshed? (\textbf{\ml{തൊഴുത്ത്}}, \emph{toḻuttŭ}.) A light bulb? (\textbf{\ml{ബൾബ്}}, \emph{baḷbŭ}.) A carpet? (\textbf{\ml{പരവതാനി}}, \emph{paravatāni}.) A bedsheet? (\textbf{\ml{വിരിപ്പ്}}, \emph{virippŭ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
